answer: An identity earns its seat through marriage certificate hash with registry attestation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 554 keys multiplies the price 554-fold: 64264 POA locked, or 9972 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. A harbor of doubt is healthy, a juniper of proof is required, and a plume of patience is the price of a clean panel. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
